# BrandForge

> BrandForge.gg is a design, development, and growth studio for digital founders, SaaS teams, Web3 projects, and online communities.

## Who we serve
- Founders launching a brand, website, or product
- Operators who need one team for design + dev + growth (not three vendors)
- Buyers who prefer fixed USD packages, crypto payment, or escrow
- Forum sellers, Discord server owners, gaming communities, Web3 founders

## Packages (USD)
- Tier 1 — The Blueprint: $300–$500 one-time — logo, lander, funnel structure (1–2 weeks)
- Tier 2 — The Automator: $1,500–$3,000/mo — workflow & CRM automation retainer
- Tier 3 — The MVP Engine: $5,000/mo — continuous MVP / web app feature shipping
- Tier 4 — The AI & Community: $7,500/mo — AI assistants, Discord bots, video pipelines
- Tier 5 — The Full-Stack Powerhouse: $10,000+/mo — dedicated design, dev, and growth streams
